title: The Red Rain Recipe
keywords: Đừng làm trái tim anh đau
segments: Linh's cozy kitchen buzzed with excitement. "This vegetarian curry will be amazing for the potluck!" she told Mai, her best friend. They had all the fresh ingredients ready: colorful vegetables, fragrant spices, and creamy coconut milk. Together, they began chopping onions, laughing as Mai accidentally dropped a carrot. The afternoon storm outside seemed far away.

But then, a strange thing happened. Outside, the rain suddenly turned a deep, unusual red, making the sky very dark. Inside Linh's cozy kitchen, the lights flickered, then went dim for a moment before coming back on. Linh looked worried. 'Oh no, the power!' she said, glancing at their half-prepared curry.

Because of this, the kitchen lights suddenly went out completely. Everything was dark and quiet. Linh sighed. 'Oh no, now what?' she whispered. Mai tried to find the flashlight. As they fumbled in the dimness, Linh looked for the special tofu for the curry. 'It's not here!' she cried, her voice shaking. 'The tofu is gone!

Mai put an arm around Linh. "Don't worry, Linh," she said softly. "We'll figure this out together." She remembered Linh's old camping stove. "Maybe we can use your camping stove for the curry? And for the tofu, what about those chickpeas in the pantry?" Linh's eyes brightened. "That's a great idea, Mai! We can do this!

Because of Mai's idea, they quickly set up the camping stove. Linh chopped the chickpeas and other vegetables while Mai carefully lit the small flame. Slowly, the delicious smell of curry filled the kitchen. Just as they stirred the last ingredients, the red rain outside stopped. A moment later, the lights flickered and came back on!

After that, with the power back, Linh and Mai quickly finished their delicious chickpea curry. They tasted it – perfect! They carefully packed the warm dish, feeling proud of their teamwork. The storm had tested them, but their friendship was stronger. They arrived at the potluck just in time, ready to share their special "Red Rain Recipe." Everyone loved it!
endWrap: Linh and Mai learned that working together makes challenges easier and their friendship stronger. Their special dish was a success, proving their teamwork made magic.
